notes.en: Qualified the 1.1.0 package with its exact shipped archive through real App tool dispatch: the real Linux/riscv64 guest (kernel 6.18.56) ran the bundled python3-stdlib generators deterministically — the hero poster produced a 3508x4961 SVG/HTML with embedded font faces byte-identical across runs, the CJK poster reported 22 fallback codepoints, --require-embedded honestly refused the unsupported embed spec with exit code 4, the PNG-to-PDF container verified the 2x2 fixture geometry and its overwrite guard exited 3, and embedded font payloads hash-matched the coverage registry with no external resource fields. Native WebKit on iPadOS 27 Simulator rendered the full-size CJK poster and on-device OCR confirmed real Chinese glyphs, not tofu. Delivery: browser.exportFile committed the 1080x1350 PNG (78,833 bytes, SHA-256 16a7f40870048e031097ee6f384cd3af2ce53690b5a452b0a6d31f8d10ae8e86); the bundled verify_png.py re-proved exactly those bytes inside the guest; workspace.publishOutput froze them into the run-owned output snapshot, byte-equal on independent after-teardown read-back; the delivered PNG and the native-export, guest-verify and publish receipts were retained before cleanup. One qualification test passed, none failed or was skipped (99.39 seconds), zero paid model calls. This review binds these exact archive bytes and the package's full declared grant surface — 12 registered tools and 5 capabilities — and the executed proof chain covers exec.shell, exec.localService static serving, the browser navigate/observe/screenshot surfaces, browser.exportFile and workspace.publishOutput; the remaining declared jobs tools were bound as registered surface, not separately exercised here. This is guest plus Simulator native qualification from a private 302-derived qualification source: browser.exportFile is not yet part of any public App release, so App availability awaits mainline integration and the mainline-owned minimumAppVersion decision — the catalog App compatibility floor is an external gate still PENDING and nothing here claims a first-capable version. Not physical-device or Apple-published-build acceptance. iOS channel only; no Android native evidence. No paid model call was made. Review approval of this package and its rights is separate from catalog publication; no download offer is made.
notes.zh-Hans: 1.1.0包已连同其确切随附归档，通过真实App工具调度完成鉴定：真实Linux/riscv64客体（内核6.18.56）确定性运行随附python3标准库生成器——hero海报生成跨次运行字节一致的3508x4961 SVG/HTML并内嵌字体面，CJK海报如实报告22个回退码位，--require-embedded以退出码4诚实拒绝不支持的内嵌规格，PNG转PDF容器自验2x2夹具几何且覆盖守卫退出3，内嵌字体载荷与覆盖注册表哈希一致且无外部资源字段。iPadOS 27模拟器下原生WebKit渲染全尺寸CJK海报，设备OCR证实为真实中文字符而非豆腐块。交付：browser.exportFile提交1080x1350 PNG（78,833字节，SHA-256 16a7f40870048e031097ee6f384cd3af2ce53690b5a452b0a6d31f8d10ae8e86）；随附verify_png.py在客体中逐字节复验该数据；workspace.publishOutput将其冻结为run-owned输出快照，拆除后独立读回仍逐字节一致；交付PNG与原生导出、客体校验、发布三份回执在清理前保留。1项鉴定测试通过，无失败无跳过（99.39秒），零付费模型调用。本审核绑定这些确切归档字节与包声明的全部授权面（12项已注册工具、5项能力）；实际执行证明链覆盖exec.shell、exec.localService静态服务、browser导航/观察/截屏面、browser.exportFile与workspace.publishOutput；其余已声明jobs工具作为已注册授权面绑定，未在本次单独执行。此为基于私有302衍生原生鉴定源的客体加模拟器鉴定：browser.exportFile尚未进入任何公开App版本，App可用性取决于主线集成与主线负责的minimumAppVersion决定——目录App兼容下限仍是外部待定门槛，本文不声称任何首个可用版本。非真机或Apple发布构建验收。仅iOS渠道；无Android原生证明。无付费模型调用。对本包及其权利的审核批准与目录发布相互独立，未产生下载供给。
